mapper.insert: INSERT INTO book (title, author, isbn, category_id, price, stock, location, description, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{title}, #{author}, #{isbn}, #{categoryId}, #{price}, #{stock}, #{location}, #{description}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE book SET title = #{title}, author = #{author}, isbn = #{isbn}, category_id = #{categoryId}, price = #{price}, stock = #{stock}, location = #{location}, description = #{description}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE book SET stock = stock - 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND stock > 0
